spec2def(xinput9_1_0.dll xinput9_1_0.spec)

# xinput9_1_0.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xinput9_1_0-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xinput9_1_0_shims OBJECT xinput9_1_0_main.c)
target_link_libraries(xinput9_1_0_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libxinput1_3)
set_wine_module(xinput9_1_0_shims)
add_cargo_module(xinput9_1_0 xinput9_1_0-cargo xinput9_1_0.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xinput9_1_0_shims psdk)
